I'm not sure I really want to fight a war, but at least we could get away from here and maybe even strike back at the Empire.|Larek Tatham, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Larek Tatham''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he visited [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], near the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]]. He accompanied his friend, [[Ulaire Roye]], a disgraced [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] who was being harassed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Tatham, sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], tried convincing Ulaire to escape Corellia so that they could both join the Rebellion.

==Behind the scenes==
Larek Tatham was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
